program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-rnd0/frozen/seen/play/users/u087/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    grid = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = 4
    row_seps = [r for r in range(h) if all(x == sep for x in grid[r])]
    col_seps = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == sep for r in range(h))]
    def intervals(n, seps):
        bounds = [-1] + seps + [n]
        return [(bounds[i] + 1, bounds[i+1]) for i in range(len(bounds)-1)]
    rows, cols = intervals(h, row_seps), intervals(w, col_seps)
    panels = [(r0, r1, c0, c1) for r0,r1 in rows for c0,c1 in cols if r1>r0 and c1>c0]
    # Select the first panel containing any non-background marks.
    background = max(set(x for row in grid for x in row if x != sep), key=lambda x: sum(v == x for row in grid for v in row))
    template = None
    for r0,r1,c0,c1 in panels:
        if any(grid[r][c] not in (background, sep) for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1)):
            template = (r0,r1,c0,c1)
            break
    if template is None:
        return grid
    r0,r1,c0,c1 = template
    pattern = [[grid[r][c] for c in range(c0,c1)] for r in range(r0,r1)]
    for a,b,x,y in panels:
        if (a,b,x,y) == template:
            continue
        if b-a != r1-r0 or y-x != c1-c0:
            continue
        if any(grid[r][c] not in (background, sep) for r in range(a,b) for c in range(x,y)):
            continue
        for dr in range(b-a):
            for dc in range(y-x):
                if pattern[dr][dc] != background:
                    grid[a+dr][x+dc] = pattern[dr][dc]
    return grid
'''
path=program_dir/'task-6fc09535.py'; path.write_text(source)
print(path)
